rag.text:
Test: TC-99003 — Admin exports configuration list to spreadsheet for audit
Priority: High | Status: Reference | Type: Manual
Folder: /Neutral/Admin - Export
Labels: neutral-golden, journey

Steps:
1. Navigate to admin configuration list
   Expected: Table of configurable items is displayed
2. Apply optional filter to a known subset
   Data: filter: Active only
   Expected: Filtered rows match criteria
3. Click **Export** and choose spreadsheet format
   Expected: Download starts
4. Open file and verify headers and row count
   Expected: Columns match UI; row count matches filtered list
